insight.headline: Securing your app, together
insight.what_changed: Merchants install your app because they trust it, and because they trust the Shopify App Store. There are bad actors out there who are motivated to exploit that trust. Alongside the rest of the industry, we are seeing the number of attacks increasing across the app ecosystem as AI gets better at finding vulnerabilities.
